company.name: Cartage
company.shortDescription: Cartage is a carpooling insurance platform.
company.description: Cartage is a carpooling insurance platform. Its objective is to enable car sharing so that everyone, everywhere, can have sustainable access to mobility while also lessening the environmental effect of the transportation sector.

productsAndServices.description: A daily insurance product that complements the owner's auto insurance to cover risks when a vehicle is lent to another driver, including young drivers, for 5€ per day.
productsAndServices.name: Cartage Daily Car Sharing Insurance

productsAndServices.description: A mobile app that enables users to subscribe quickly to Cartage insurance, manage car sharing history, perform vehicle condition reports, and generate car sharing contracts.
productsAndServices.name: Cartage Mobile Application

productsAndServices.description: A tailored insurance solution for organizations, territories, or communities to implement car sharing among their members, such as employees or residents.
productsAndServices.name: Cartage Community Car Sharing Insurance Offer

insights.title: Funding is concentrated in the latest major round
insights.statement: The latest disclosed Seed round raised $542,270, or 100% of reported total funding.
insights.implication: This round accounts for most reported historical financing, making it important when assessing funding-source concentration and fundraising cadence.

insights.title: Valuation increased across disclosed rounds
insights.statement: Known post-money valuation rose from $3,708,102 to $3,708,102, a 1x increase.
insights.implication: The disclosed financing history indicates a material valuation step-up between the earliest and latest rounds with known valuations.
caveats: Only rounds with a disclosed post-money valuation are compared.

insights.title: Sharp recent attention and growth momentum
insights.statement: Crunchbase scores growth at 85 (-2 over 90 days) and market heat at 79 (-5).
insights.implication: The company has recently become much more visible, but the scores should be treated as attention/activity indicators rather than revenue or clinical-performance metrics.
caveats: Crunchbase does not expose the complete weighting behind these proprietary scores.
